quietSpot.title: Find a quiet spot
quietSpot.script: Find a quiet spot. Move toys and other distractions out of view. Turn off extra screens and other sounds. Make sure light comes from the computer side, onto your baby’s face. Avoid a bright window behind your baby, which can make their face hard to see.

walkthroughPrimer.title: First, a quick walkthrough
walkthroughPrimer.script: First, a quick walkthrough. The next six short steps use illustrations and parent-and-baby videos to show you when to wait, when to press the space bar, and how to pause. Just watch and listen for now. You’ll practice afterward, and your baby can join later. When you’re ready, choose Start the walkthrough.

updates.title: 1. Watch the screen
updates.copy: Wait for the video to finish, then monitor your baby’s attention to the screen.
updates.caption: If your baby looks away for 3 seconds, press the space bar.
updates.script: One. Watch the screen. Wait for the video to finish, then monitor your baby’s attention to the screen. If your baby looks away for three seconds, press the space bar.
When the picture is still, if your baby looks away from the screen for three full seconds, press the space bar once. Your baby must keep looking away for all three seconds, without looking back.
